native.language_pooling: masked mean of native Florence/BART input embeddings
native.sampling: native ten-step recurrence with explicit per-call torch.Generator
native.postprocess: entire [1,30,4] once; original processor transfers result to CPU once

heads_initialization: random; zero mean and unit scale; no old PI05 feature weights
visual_input: native 1024-channel spatial tokens -> 4x4 pooling -> fixed random orthogonal channel projection to 256 -> 4096
language_input: native masked token embedding mean; zero padded to 2048; task cache
Q_preprocessing: random orthogonal native visual8192->16 and language2048->8; zero centers/unit scale; no PI05 buffers
correction: raw-action gradient * native S squared; own-radius project_solo
